//: Arenas (Phase 5): where the court stands, how it is lit and what is round it. Looks were matched to the reference photos in reference/photos.json with the photo-match mode (?photo=<id>); DECISIONS.md (Phase 5) has what each number came from. Colours are sRGB hex; light intensities are three.js units (directional/hemisphere: lux-like scale with AgX tone mapping at `exposure`).

stadium.name: Arena (indoor, TV)
stadium.//kind: Pro events are played in sports halls and arenas: tiered stands on four sides, a coloured surround, boards, a high lit roof (arena-wide, arena-wide-2, arena-glass).
stadium.//floor: Tournament courts are blue sand-filled turf; little sand shows on a new tournament carpet. Blue matched under the arena's light against arena-wide-2.
stadium.//surround: Red turf round the glass out to about 4.5 m at the sides and 6.5 m at the ends (arena-wide-2), then the hall floor.
stadium.//base: The light grey steel the glass panels stand on, visible as a pale line round the court in every panoramic reference.
stadium.//camera: The change-of-ends swing climbs 2.5 m at its middle to pass over the side stands' back rows (on the end's 25.5 m circle at 7.6 m the lens went through them). Only here: in the hall it would go through the roof.
stadium.//light: A pro event on TV (the 2026 final's broadcast frame): a lit court in a dark hall. This was a bright roof whose baked environment gave over half the light and, at the camera's low angle, a grey specular veil on the floor: the lit floor came out 1.7 times its own colour and every shadow was filled in. Now the key gives most of the light from high and a little behind the camera, so shadows fall up the screen and the camera-side of a player is lit, the environment is 0.35 and the floor renders about at its hex (authored B 200, shown 181; was R 75 against 37). Dark hall, dim lamps: the stands fall away.

hall.name: Club hall (covered)
hall.//kind: A covered club: a steel shed over two courts, open or half-open sides, daylight from the sides and the roof (hall, hall-2).
hall.//neighbours: Covered clubs put two or more courts side by side under one roof, about 2.5 m apart (hall, hall-2).

club-day.name: Club (outdoor, day)
club-day.//kind: An outdoor club court in a park: grass and paths round it, trees, a neighbour's fence, floodlight poles on the side mesh (day-framed, day-panoramic, day-hyde, day-lights).
club-day.//neighbours: Clubs build courts in rows, side by side about 2.5 m apart (night, day-panoramic, Club Kingswood).

club-night.name: Club (outdoor, night)
club-night.//kind: The same club at night under its floodlights: LED heads on 6-7 m poles at the ends of the side mesh, a dark sky, pools of light on the court and darkness beyond (night).
club-night.//surround: Dark green turf round the courts and between them (night).
club-night.//neighbours: Clubs build courts in rows, side by side about 2.5 m apart (night, day-panoramic, Club Kingswood).
club-night.//floods: Eight heads (two per pole, four poles); spot lights aimed at the court. Only one casts a shadow (cost); the others light without. Intensity 16: exposed like a broadcast of a lit court, the turf near the camera about as bright as by day (luminance 120-126) and darker towards the glass (review round 3, critic #5: at 95 the turf rendered at 234, more than twice the day, and the centre line at 251 stood out by 7%).

club-dusk.name: Club (outdoor, sunset)
club-dusk.//kind: A secret arena (M6 phase E: a Regional title in the career opens it, data/career.json `arenas`): the same club as the sun goes down, a low warm sun from the side, the sky going from orange at the horizon to blue overhead, the floodlights just on. Not matched to a reference photo: a look of our own.

club-golden.name: Club (outdoor, golden hour)
club-golden.//kind: The look pass's club (owner, 20 Nov: graphics like a padel game's reel): a park club late in the afternoon, a photographed sky (Poly Haven rustig_koppie_puresky, CC0) whose sun is the key light, trees close round the court throwing their shadows across it. Not matched to a reference photo: a look of our own, built to the owner's request.
club-golden.//surround: Dark green turf round the court, a little sandy and worn (the reel's clubs, club-night). Sand 0.12, not the court's: a surround is not top-dressed and played on, and at 0.3 the sunlit pile seen low towards the sun showed only its sand, beige as concrete.
club-golden.//hdri: tools/assets/golden/build-sky.sh: the sun 28.3 deg up, turned to azimuth -55 deg (behind the far end, to the right), its irradiance 16.85 in the photograph's units scaled to the key's 3.8 (scale = 0.5 x 3.8 / 16.85); the sky lights the ground 10.7 times less than the sun does. The disc is drawn at 300, not its real 56,000: it only has to bloom.
club-golden.//grove: Palms in a row 4 m outside each side glass from the far end to 8 m short of the near one, and three behind the far end (the near end is the broadcast camera's: 7.6 m up, 25 m out; a palm there stood across the picture), 6.5-9.5 m; behind them a wood of 70 impostor trees (olive and broadleaf, tools/assets/golden/impostor.py, 1.3-2x the bake's 3.4-5 m) outside the surround, none in a 32 m wide lane from the near end to 36 m out. The sun is behind the far right corner, so the right-hand palms throw their shadows across the court.
club-golden.//haze: Late-afternoon air: the court (within 35 m of the broadcast camera) clear, the wood behind it up to about 10% towards the horizon's colour, 30% at 150 m (0.35 from 26 m greyed the far end like fog).
club-golden.//meshShadow: The low sun lays the mesh's grid across the turf (the reel's courts show it). Drawn by the floor itself (render/meshShade.ts): each point's ray to the sun through the walls' mesh, the wires blurred by the sun's disc at their distance, so the grid is sharp beside mesh that comes down to the floor and the high strips give their average. No shadow map resolves 2.8 mm wire (the 2048 cut-out only ever showed the average).
club-golden.//leaves: Dry leaves off the wood, crowded against the foot of the cage outside (falling off over about 1.6 m) and within half a metre of the walls inside, most in the corners.

light.//reflect: The glass shows the baked scene at its own level (the photograph is scaled so its sun is the key): the 3.2 above is for the shade's ambient only, and on the glass it laid a pale haze over the ground seen through it.
light.//key: The photographed sun (#fffaed, measured). 3.8 x sin(28.3) = 1.8 on the ground, as the day club's sun gives. The frustum: the court seen from the sun is about 20 x 10 m, plus the surround the camera shows.
light.//hemi: None: the baked environment (the photographed sky, the sunlit turf) is the ambient light, at 3.2 times the photograph's level: the bare sky lit the shade 11 times less than the sun (the turf in shade measured at 1/29 of the sun with env 1, 1/14 with env 2, 1/9 with 3.2, tone-mapped), and the shade under the palms went black; a club has walls, trees and ground round it that the pure sky has not, and photographs of courts in low sun show the shade at a fifth to a sixth of the sun.

final.name: Final court (indoor, TV)
final.//kind: A secret arena (M6 phase E: reaching the Masters in the career opens it, and the Masters Final is played there): the arena dressed for a final, green turf on a navy surround, gold boards, a full house and the stands darker under a brighter court. Not matched to a reference photo: a look of our own.
